description:
## 1.0.0 (2026-11-28)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* disable streamer highlights and chat navigation by default ([49b887e](https://github.com/renovate-bot/snowyegret23-_-morphe-patches/commit/49b887e83f9178ecbe9999e71d999ee5b7084005))
* keep Morphe settings visible when notifications are disabled ([e2535a2](https://github.com/renovate-bot/snowyegret23-_-morphe-patches/commit/e2535a2407a308098eae6719fceab2756fa17249))
* preserve exception handlers when removing playback ads ([f79104f](https://github.com/renovate-bot/snowyegret23-_-morphe-patches/commit/f79104f2468076027c9f060cfdd046174f8e6f59))
* refresh chat controls and prevent runtime library conflicts ([5b5ec02](https://github.com/renovate-bot/snowyegret23-_-morphe-patches/commit/5b5ec02c7e9e48f5a988f3a11e24393e2261f5ef))
* restore CHZZK 3.16.0 startup after APK signing ([737c35b](https://github.com/renovate-bot/snowyegret23-_-morphe-patches/commit/737c35bdeff922b14551f533700d726992379c26))
* restore complete CHZZK 3.18.0 mobile patch support ([7c6cfde](https://github.com/renovate-bot/snowyegret23-_-morphe-patches/commit/7c6cfde6be05b8d57f8c809d1aedd33dc35ccb00))
* restore startup on CHZZK 3.18.0 and TV 1.5.0 ([c377fad](https://github.com/renovate-bot/snowyegret23-_-morphe-patches/commit/c377fad4f3c9723a89119e570fbe6b25798d5065))

### ✨ New Features

* add audio compression, volume boost and font step controls ([45cd415](https://github.com/renovate-bot/snowyegret23-_-morphe-patches/commit/45cd4155602ff4bf2ea60a158ff8a6493a2052a2))
* add configurable CHZZK chat and live player patches ([acb7e59](https://github.com/renovate-bot/snowyegret23-_-morphe-patches/commit/acb7e595e908518aa06aa677523d29419a9c6bee))
* add experimental CHZZK Android TV customization ([f3ee87c](https://github.com/renovate-bot/snowyegret23-_-morphe-patches/commit/f3ee87cc2784e9660b2197007f14e1a0a289fbfd))
* add local follows, alerts, filters and playback diagnostics ([1180bcf](https://github.com/renovate-bot/snowyegret23-_-morphe-patches/commit/1180bcfb4583966e66e906fbf24fffa44dfe41a1))
* add overlay controls and playback compatibility settings ([de7f0fc](https://github.com/renovate-bot/snowyegret23-_-morphe-patches/commit/de7f0fc6577bc3e3caf0198301a2ae6a943804a9))
* add streamer chat highlighting and chat navigation ([771af36](https://github.com/renovate-bot/snowyegret23-_-morphe-patches/commit/771af366626b6bc3a2f1866bac31380cdb2d8203))
* make broadcast-time label optional [skip ci] ([289cc77](https://github.com/renovate-bot/snowyegret23-_-morphe-patches/commit/289cc778ca4b1204ecb57bd7f5bb940c4b8a6046))
* **minor:** improve live catch-up and add buffer controls ([d3a142a](https://github.com/renovate-bot/snowyegret23-_-morphe-patches/commit/d3a142ad15387e08d96f0c5ded48175e770977fc))
* **minor:** skip mobile-only patches on CHZZK for Android TV ([1e812de](https://github.com/renovate-bot/snowyegret23-_-morphe-patches/commit/1e812de8ceba4a1add63cabadd60f7caec44fde4)), references [#20](https://github.com/renovate-bot/snowyegret23-_-morphe-patches/issues/20)
* support CHZZK 3.14.10 alongside 3.14.0 ([d723cb7](https://github.com/renovate-bot/snowyegret23-_-morphe-patches/commit/d723cb7692fb1396afc0693ac94cf711cb4c201c))
* support CHZZK 3.15.0 and add configurable viewer count ([2ccfb77](https://github.com/renovate-bot/snowyegret23-_-morphe-patches/commit/2ccfb777bc797027cc0470ad5b3d2c53f3b84d4f))
* support CHZZK 3.16.0 with chat, seeking and audio controls ([e795d4a](https://github.com/renovate-bot/snowyegret23-_-morphe-patches/commit/e795d4a928328cae45103f526af7652af06a7c70)), closes [#7](https://github.com/renovate-bot/snowyegret23-_-morphe-patches/issues/7) [#8](https://github.com/renovate-bot/snowyegret23-_-morphe-patches/issues/8) [#9](https://github.com/renovate-bot/snowyegret23-_-morphe-patches/issues/9)
* support new CHZZK versions and channel local follows ([c5fe6e0](https://github.com/renovate-bot/snowyegret23-_-morphe-patches/commit/c5fe6e0a39a70c5815d32732bb10ef901d639e98)), closes [#13](https://github.com/renovate-bot/snowyegret23-_-morphe-patches/issues/13) [#14](https://github.com/renovate-bot/snowyegret23-_-morphe-patches/issues/14)

### 🚀 Updated App Support

* support all patches on CHZZK for Android TV 1.5.0 ([4fe32b2](https://github.com/renovate-bot/snowyegret23-_-morphe-patches/commit/4fe32b2f75256db1d39f7df78ad74155eb689a1e))
* support CHZZK 3.15.2 alongside previous versions ([dc58a42](https://github.com/renovate-bot/snowyegret23-_-morphe-patches/commit/dc58a427b25a44500f7257a83facff7ebe471be1))
